description: Scope-defer honesty failure. The iter-3 manifest claims the 8 scope-deferred items each have CONCRETE acceptance criteria in a 'Sprint-2/Sprint-3 Scope Cut table in behavioral-spec.md'. PASS-encouragement was conditioned on honest scope-cut documentation; that condition is not met.
